# Technical Plan: Mamba/Attention/Router/Shared-Expert Offloading for Nemotron-H on 12GB GPU

## 1. Architecture Analysis & Tensor Inventory

The Nemotron-H model (identified as `LLM_TYPE_31B_A3_5B` for 52 layers) employs a hybrid architecture with **recurrent Mamba2 SSM layers**, **standard attention layers**, and **Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)** with shared experts. The critical tensors and their memory footprints for a single layer are derived from `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp`:

### Critical Tensor Dimensions & Memory
| Tensor Name | Shape | Type | Memory per Layer (FP16) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ssm_in` | `{n_embd, d_in_proj}` | Weight | ~16KB *(Recurrent only)* |
| `ssm_conv1d` | `{d_conv, d_inner + 2*n_group*d_state}` | Weight | ~16KB *(Recurrent only)* |
| `ssm_out` | `{d_inner, n_embd}` | Weight | ~16KB *(Recurrent only)* |
| `ffn_gate_inp` | `{n_embd, n_expert}` | Weight | ~64KB *(MoE only)* |
| `ffn_down_exps` | `{n_ff_exp, moe_n_embd, n_expert}` | Weight | ~64KB *(MoE only)* |
| `ffn_up_exps` | `{moe_n_embd, n_ff_exp, n_expert}` | Weight | ~64KB *(MoE only)* |
| `ffn_down_shexp` | `{n_ff_shexp, n_embd}` | Weight | ~32KB *(Shared expert)* |
| `ffn_up_shexp` | `{n_embd, n_ff_shexp}` | Weight | ~32KB *(Shared expert)* |
| `attn_norm` | `{n_embd}` | Weight | ~0.5MB *(All layers)* |
| `wo` (Attn out) | `{n_embd_head_k * n_head_i, n_embd}` | Weight | ~0.5MB-2MB *(All layers)* |

**Total per-MoE Layer:** ~2
